description: For a dynaset and a table-type recordset over F opened with Options omitted and then with dbReadOnly (4), with held Fields ID and N: read Updatable, Updatable-related Field properties DataUpdatable and Attributes of ID and N; Edit, assign N 5, Update, Errors, EditMode; AddNew, assign ID 20, Update, Errors; Delete, Errors; CancelUpdate; close. Asks whether dbReadOnly refuses each write member and at which call, and what Updatable and DataUpdatable report. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
